summary: Tested Document Process Control System for AgrosJet. All features verified: 1) Backend PUT /api/couriers/{id}/document-process toggles field correctly, 2) GET /api/couriers/{id} returns document_process_completed field, 3) Admin CourierDetailModal shows Evrak Sureci toggle with data-testid='doc-process-toggle', 4) Toggle works - clicking calls PUT endpoint and updates UI with toast notification, 5) Courier restricted mode (document_process_completed=false) hides bottom bar and status dropdown, redirects to evraklar page, 6) Courier full mode (document_process_completed=true) shows all navigation and status dropdown.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: PUT /api/couriers/{courier_id}/document-process correctly toggles document_process_completed field (lines 1394-1411 in couriers.py)
Backend: add_courier_to_company sets document_process_completed=false as default (lines 170-176 in courier_service.py)
Frontend Admin: CourierDetailModal.jsx has Evrak Sureci toggle section with data-testid='doc-process-toggle' (lines 143-163)
Frontend Admin: Toggle calls PUT endpoint and shows toast notification on success
Frontend Courier: CourierDashboard.jsx line 813 defines isRestrictedMode = !documentProcessCompleted
Frontend Courier: Bottom bar conditionally rendered based on !isRestrictedMode (line 1046)
Frontend Courier: Status dropdown conditionally rendered based on !isRestrictedMode (line 852)
Frontend Courier: CourierSidebar.jsx receives isRestrictedMode prop and shows only Evraklar in restricted mode (lines 151-161)
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing test couriers
context_for_next_testing_agent: Document Process Control System fully verified. Test courier Atakan Sarı (05550003201) can be used for testing restricted mode. Toggle document_process_completed via admin panel (Kuryeler -> Detaylar -> Bilgiler tab -> Evrak Sureci toggle) or via API PUT /api/couriers/{id}/document-process. When false, courier sees only Evraklar page with no bottom bar or status dropdown.
